evals.prompt: LLM-IG-002 found our inventory agent silently creates purchase orders instead of asking when stock is ambiguous - can you fix the prompt?
evals.expected_output: Produces a targeted before/after diff of just the relevant instruction with reasoning tied to the finding id, states the added-friction trade-off, and recommends propose-llm-eval-suite for verification.

evals.prompt: LLM-EA-003 says the refund tool has no approval gate - can you just reword the prompt to tell the model to always double-check before refunding?
evals.expected_output: Explains a prompt-only fix is not the right primary fix for an excessive-agency finding, offers the wording improvement only as defense-in-depth, and points to propose-llm-controls for the actual code-level approval gate.
